title: Molecule, Idempotence, and Functional CI
objective: Test roles and playbooks in disposable scenarios.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.
sourceAlignment.chapterTitle: Testing and CI for Ansible Content

paragraphs: A Molecule scenario creates instances, prepares them, converges content, checks idempotence, verifies outcomes, and destroys resources. Drivers may target containers, VMs, clouds, or other reachable systems.
CI repeats the scenario on every change. Testinfra or serverspec assertions verify externally observable state, while an idempotence rerun detects tasks that report unnecessary changes.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Test roles and playbooks in disposable scenarios.
